text: This is the Civic Voice. You are valued. Your value has been noted.
Reminder: contentment is a shared resource. Please do not hoard it.
Queues are a form of community. Please enjoy yours.
Citizens are reminded that water is provided. Gratitude is optional but recorded.
A lost item has been found: one sense of proportion. Please claim it at any window.
The Stacks cat is not a citizen. Please stop registering it.
Form 12-B is the Application for Application. Do not apply for the application to apply.
All rules are equal. Some rules are more equal at Window 7.
If you see something, say something. If you say something, we will see you.
Noise is a gift from you to your neighbours. Please give less.
A tidy citizen is an unremarkable citizen. Unremarkable is the goal.
Thank you for being exactly where you are supposed to be.
Good morning. The day has been scheduled for you. Please enjoy it in order.
It is midday. Lunch is permitted for twenty minutes. Chewing is encouraged.
Productivity in the afternoon is up by a number we are pleased with.
The Pump 4 night crew changes shift at 22:00. Please do not wave.
Evening is for rest. Rest is a duty. Please do your duty.
Curfew is in force. Citizens without a night pass are reminded that they are being thought of.
It is late. Home is where your registered address is. Please be there.
Quiet Hours are the city's gift to itself. Please do not wake it.
Sleep is mandatory for those assigned it. Dreams must be declared in the morning.
The lights you can see are watching over you. The lights you cannot see are doing the same.
The city is calm. Please keep it that way by being calm in it.
A citizen is being unusual. Please be usual on their behalf.
Robots are assisting a citizen. Please do not help the citizen. Thank you.
The city is closed for your safety. It will reopen when you have forgotten why.
Contentment is currently under target. A reminder will be issued to each of you separately.
Contentment is excellent. If you do not feel it, please report to the nearest window.
A disturbance in order has been noted. Order will be restored by being restored.
Power is being conserved on your behalf. The darkness is a form of efficiency.
Citizens who have been processed once are reminded that the process is gentle. Once.
A repeat citizen has been noticed. The city is not angry. The city is attentive.
One citizen has been processed three times and is now eligible for personal attention. Case Officer Halloran-7 is available.
Files that contain contradictions may be corrected. Files that contain citizens may be forgotten.
This citizen has never been processed. This citizen is a credit to the form.
A recording of an unauthorised song has been corrected. The song was never played. The song was lovely.
Please do not assemble information. It is inefficient and it is often wrong.
Statistics show that eight in ten citizens are better off than the other two. Please do not check.
A report from an informant has been received and is being lovingly ignored.
Walking is permitted. Wandering is a different form, and has not been filed.
